# Zizeg

> Zizeg is a native macOS Markdown editor. Edit the same plain `.md` file in a rendered view or raw Markdown; both are fully editable, stay in sync automatically, and save directly to the file on disk — no vault or proprietary format.

Zizeg is designed for Markdown in everyday work, including the READMEs, instruction files, specifications, plans, changelogs, and summaries that accumulate around AI-assisted workflows. Zizeg itself does not use AI or send documents to an AI service. Safety checks never rewrite the saved source: sanitization happens only during rendering and export, remote images stay blocked until approved, and unsafe or unsupported content is visibly flagged.

Zizeg is free to download and use for viewing or rendering Markdown files. A one-time purchase or subscription with a free trial unlocks editing and export. Markdown support deliberately covers CommonMark and GFM — including tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, and images — without math/LaTeX, footnotes, or Mermaid diagrams.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-29.
